_comment: Lane ownership for the shared Claude + Cursor working tree: plan.md section 2.1 and contract K-51 COORD-1 (docs/CONTRACTS.md).
Read by scripts/coord/check_lane.py and enforced by the pre-commit hook (scripts/coord/precommit.py) on every commit.
Patterns are repo-relative POSIX globs: '*' and '?' stay inside one path segment, '**' spans directories, 'dir/**' covers everything below dir.
When several patterns match a path, the most specific wins: an exact path beats any glob, then the glob with more literal characters (tests/test_whatsapp.py beats tests/*.py).
Shared files may be committed by any agent; append_only files reject removed or changed lines. A path that matches nothing is in no lane: Claude adds it here.
Only Claude edits this file; Cursor asks in plan.md section 11 (Handoff). Who owns a path: python scripts/coord/check_lane.py --whoowns <path>
